title: CITERIFT Stage 04 projection set, version 1
description: The stored v1 projection bodies of one report (owner decision D-047, SPEC 11.2): a content-addressed blob named by report_recorded.projection_set. The digests are sorted ascending and unique; report_recorded.projection_count equals their number; every digest names a published blob. Checked by Investigation Memory.

projections.description: SHA-256 digests of the stored v1 projection bodies, one per distinct work (Stage 02 identity anchor) with a positive claim. A body is a v1 investigation record (schemas/contracts/v1, unchanged) without created_at; each digest is the SHA-256 of the canonical encoding of the body blob it names. created_at (the at of investigation_created) is added only when a record is exported (SPEC 11.2), so an exported record does not hash to its digest; the export names each record file by this body digest.
